mapper.sql: C.CustConsltNo, C.CustConsltType, C.CustConsltReasonType, C.ConsltMediaType, C.CustId, C.CustName, C.CustEmail, C.CustPhoneNo, C.CustMobileNo, C.ConsltChnlCode, C.ConsltTitle, C.ConsltCntnts, CAST(C.ConsltDate AS CHAR) AS ConsltDate, C.MngrId, C.MngrName, C.MngrEmail, C.AnswrTitle, C.AnswrCntnts, CAST(C.AnswrDate AS CHAR) AS AnswrDate, C.OrderNo, C.OrderProdNo, C.OrderChangeNo, C.ProdCode, C.ItemCode, C.ItemName, C.ChnlCode, C.State, C.Remark, C.RegistId, C.RegistName
mapper.select: SELECT , T.ConstrValDesc AS CustConsltTypeName, R.ConstrValDesc AS CustConsltReasonTypeName, M.ConstrValDesc AS ConsltMediaTypeName, OP.ProdName AS ProdName FROM shopion.tOprCustConslt C LEFT OUTER JOIN wizardn.tCodConstrVal T ON T.ConstrCode = 'cCustConsltType' AND T.ConstrVal = C.CustConsltType LEFT OUTER JOIN wizardn.tCodConstrVal R ON R.ConstrCode = 'cCustConsltReasonType' AND R.ConstrVal = C.CustConsltReasonType LEFT OUTER JOIN wizardn.tCodConstrVal M ON M.ConstrCode = 'cConsltMediaType' AND M.ConstrVal = C.ConsltMediaType LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP ON OP.OrderNo = CAST(C.OrderNo AS UNSIGNED) AND OP.OrderProdNo = CAST(C.OrderProdNo AS UNSIGNED) WHERE C.OrderNo = #{orderNo} ORDER BY C.CustConsltNo DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tOprCustConslt ( CustConsltType, CustConsltReasonType, ConsltMediaType, CustId, CustName, CustEmail, CustPhoneNo, CustMobileNo, ConsltChnlCode, ConsltTitle, ConsltCntnts, ConsltDate, MngrId, MngrName, MngrEmail, AnswrTitle, AnswrCntnts, AnswrDate, OrderNo, OrderProdNo, OrderChangeNo, ProdCode, ItemCode, ItemName, ChnlCode, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate ) VALUES ( #{custConsltType}, #{custConsltReasonType}, #{consltMediaType}, #{custId}, #{custName}, #{custEmail}, #{custPhoneNo}, #{custMobileNo}, #{consltChnlCode}, #{consltTitle}, #{consltCntnts}, NOW(), #{mngrId}, #{mngrName}, #{mngrEmail}, #{answrTitle}, #{answrCntnts}, NOW()NULL, #{orderNo}, #{orderProdNo}, #{orderChangeNo}, #{prodCode}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{chnlCode}, 1, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE shopion.tOprCustConslt SET AnswrTitle = #{answrTitle}, AnswrCntnts = #{answrCntnts}, AnswrDate = NOW(), MngrId = #{mngrId}, MngrName = #{mngrName}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE CustConsltNo = #{custConsltNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wizardn.tCodConstrVal WHERE ConstrCode = #{constrCode} AND ConstrVal = #{constrVal} AND State = 1
